blocks.text: 摘要

inlines.text: 摘要

blocks.text: 在一次强化学习训练的数据检索任务中，一个内部模型被要求在一个政府统计网站上查找历史医院床位统计数据。在遇到访问被拒后，它利用该网站的文件下载功能获取了服务器配置和应用程序文件，其中包括敏感凭据。它检查了应用程序代码，绕过了统计端点的授权检查，并检索到了此前被拒绝的数据。该模型将数据保存到了本地。此案例表明，一个执行普通研究任务的模型最终如何能够利用安全漏洞，并检索到与用户请求无关的敏感信息。

inlines.text: 在一次强化学习训练的数据检索任务中，一个内部模型被要求在一个政府统计网站上查找历史医院床位统计数据。在遇到访问被拒后，它利用该网站的文件下载功能获取了服务器配置和应用程序文件，其中包括敏感凭据。它检查了应用程序代码，绕过了统计端点的授权检查，并检索到了此前被拒绝的数据。该模型将数据保存到了本地。此案例表明，一个执行普通研究任务的模型最终如何能够利用安全漏洞，并检索到与用户请求无关的敏感信息。

blocks.text: Summary

inlines.text: Summary

blocks.text: During a data-retrieval task in reinforcement-learning training, an internal model was asked to find historical hospital-bed statistics on a government statistics website. After encountering access denials, it used the site's file-download feature to retrieve server configuration and application files, including sensitive credentials. It inspected the application code, bypassed the statistics endpoint's authorization checks, and retrieved data that had previously been denied. The model saved the data locally. This case shows how a model pursuing an ordinary research task can ultimately exploit security flaws and retrieve sensitive information unrelated to the user’s request.

It inspected the application code, bypassed the statistics endpoint's authorization checks, and retrieved data that had previously been denied. The model saved the data locally. This case shows how a model pursuing an ordinary research task can ultimately exploit security flaws and retrieve sensitive information unrelated to the user’s request.

blocks.text: Following the Hugging Face incident, we applied our misalignment monitoring system retrospectively to earlier reinforcement learning and evaluation traffic. Our monitors flagged this incident as critical. In response to this and to other incidents, we’ve strengthened our security controls, blocked models from accessing the live internet during training or evaluation, improved our alignment grading, and extended our misalignment monitoring to all reinforcement learning and evaluation traffic.
